rationale: The discourse has become highly quantified and process-aligned, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labor/state insist on no closures and no compulsory redundancies, while management/owners/investors keep closures and forced reductions available if the deep non-closure package falls short. Positions are now stable and repetitive, so further unstructured rounds are unlikely to change the deadlock without a structured intervention around concrete scenarios and milestones.
